basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast from Leeds, UK, I've always been drawn to the latest gadgets and streaming technologies. I work as a network administrator for a mid-sized tech firm, which feeds my curiosity about all things internet-related. Outside of work, I'm a huge fan of alternative music, especially artists like slowthai, and enjoy playing around with virtual instruments. I'm usually online during the evenings and weekends, often exploring new tech or engaging in discussions about bass guitar setups. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience in network management, I've developed a strong understanding of networking protocols and hardware. My professional life involves constant troubleshooting and optimization of network systems, which has naturally extended into my personal interests, particularly in streaming technologies and gaming.
